notes.subject: וצלחה
notes.rationale: Bontshišo bja go rusha ka maatla (KJV 'come mightily') kgahlanong le 'go atlega' (ylt 'prospered') — mo go tsewa bontshišo bja maatla.

notes.subject: ruakh
notes.rationale: ruakh e bolokwa ka modumo wa Seheberu; e bolela Moya, phefo le go hema ka lentšu le tee.

notes.subject: go Sause
notes.rationale: Samele o bolela ka go sebetsana le Sause ka tlwaelo — 'go wena' ka moka.

translation: Gomme ruakh ya Yahwe e tla o gapa ka maatla, gomme o tla profeta le bona, gomme o tla fetoga go ba motho yo mongwe.

tokens.gloss: e tla o gapa ka maatla
